name: Quiet capitulation reversal
tagline: Buys TQQQ after a quiet multi-horizon QQQ decline and holds one session.
summary: Triggers on a -3% 3-session, -5% 10-session or -8% 15-session QQQ decline on volume at most 1.2x its 20-day average, then buys TQQQ at the event close and holds one session. The 1 bp development result is 39.75% CAGR, but it fails at 5 bp (34.67%) and the 2024-26 holdout earns only 13.02%, leaving the full record at 32.21%.
caveat: The 1 bp pass is fragile - the 1.2x volume cap is a cliff, P&L is concentrated in a few 2020-22 events, and the 2024-26 holdout earns only 13.02%, so the full CAGR misses the 37.54% bar by 5.3 pp.
